post.description: Links a wallet the signed-in user owns in Privy to their Music Nerd account. If a legacy (pre-Privy) account already has that wallet, the two are merged into the legacy account, which takes over the Privy identity and the signed-in account's contributions and comes back as `userId`. A name the user confirmed in the welcome flow wins over the legacy name.

walletAddress.description: An EVM wallet address. It must be one of the wallets linked to the caller's Privy account; it is stored lower-cased.

200.description: The wallet is linked. `merged: true` means a legacy account was found and merged; `userId` is then the surviving account's id, which the client must use from now on.

merged.summary: A legacy account had this wallet

value.message: Account merged successfully! Your contribution history has been restored.

linked.summary: No legacy account; the wallet is saved on the current account

400.description: The body isn't JSON (`Invalid request body`), or `walletAddress` isn't a `0x` address of 40 hex characters (`Invalid wallet address`).

401.description: No token, an invalid or expired token, no Music Nerd user for it, or a user without a Privy identity.

403.description: Privy does not list this wallet among the caller's linked accounts. A browser callback is not proof of ownership.

example.error: Wallet is not linked to your authenticated account.

409.description: The legacy account with this wallet already belongs to another Privy identity.

example.error: This wallet is already linked to another account

500.description: The merge was rolled back (`Merge failed`, `User not found`, `Current user has no Privy ID`, `Legacy account is already linked to another user`), or the wallet could not be saved (`Failed to link wallet`). Nothing changed.

503.description: Privy could not be reached to verify wallet ownership. Try again.

example.error: Wallet verification unavailable. Please try again.

privyBearer.description: The signed-in user's access token. Copy it at https://musicnerd.net/access after signing in. Any Music Nerd user; the account is the token's, never the request's.

merged.description: True when a legacy account with this wallet was merged into.

userId.description: Only when `merged` is true: the surviving (legacy) account's id. The caller's token now maps to this account.
